source_text.body:
Run daily client outreach with a looping Claude agent
A web developer built an agent that takes a domain, works out what it sells, finds prospects and emails them daily, waking every 15 minutes via claude -p to handle replies.
·
Nov 18, 2026
Done with
CC
Claude Code
CL
Claude
What they did
The developer wanted to show Claude Code could run an always-on agent without extra hardware. The first version took a domain, worked out what the product sells, found prospects and emailed them. Using claude -p in a loop, it woke every 15 minutes to fill the pipeline and handle replies, then slept. He later added a browser UI for tracking and feedback.
How it went
A test campaign emailing tech business owners worked after some back and forth. The open source repo later reached 6.4k stars, 35+ contributors and 200+ merged PRs, though he never marketed it and says he doesn't know why it took off.
Worth knowing
The first working version took about a day; the real effort went into email quality, prospect sources, email verification and warming integrations.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Build me a looping outreach agent for [my domain/business]. Each day it should read my site to work out what I sell, find [number] prospects who fit, and draft a short personalized email to each; every 15 minutes it should also check my inbox for replies and draft responses. Do not send any email yet: show me the prospect list and first drafts, and pause for my approval before sending anything, including later replies.
Original source: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50548283
